summary: The live /tokens page enforced the least-privilege contract, required an explicit credential whitelist selection, and successfully issued a real token. The success state showed a one-time token display, token ID, scope, selected credential count, and expiry metadata. A stale localhost curl example remains visible after issuance, but the issuance workflow itself worked.
contract_findings: The tokens page hard-locks scope to credential:read and describes a sandbox-only usage model.
The issue action remained disabled until a credential whitelist entry was selected.
The success screen displayed the full token only once and included Token ID, scope, credential count, issue time, and expiry time.
No revoke/delete affordance was visible on the captured issuance success state.
The visible curl example on the success state still targets http://localhost:8080/api/v1/sandbox/sessions instead of the live environment host.
